objects.description:
[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) had registered domains that would point to a typo-squatted domain used to deliver malicious payloads.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticore_May2026) 

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has also pre-shared credentials with a link to spoofed phishing login pages that enable the download of malicious payloads when authorized credentials are used.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)
